excerpt: Though the total cross section is large by neutrino standards, CEvNS has long proven difficult to detect, since the deposited energy into the nucleus is ~ keV. In 2017, the COHERENT collaboration announced the detection of CEvNS using a stopped-pion source with CsI detectors.
publisher: arXiv (preprint); M. Abdullah, H. Abele, D. Akimov, G. Angloher et al. (275 authors)
title: Coherent elastic neutrino-nucleus scattering: Terrestrial and astrophysical applications
